title: Latent Cache Flow: Model-to-Model Communication Without Text
authors: Maximillian Rossi; Prajwal Raghunath; Eugene Wu
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, KV cache compression

problem_statement.en: Text-mediated communication between LLM agents incurs autoregressive decoding latency and loses information during discrete-token projection. Cache-to-Cache avoids text but uses a 956 MB position-wise adapter and requires sharer and receiver contexts to be token-aligned, which is unsuitable when agents have different contexts.
problem_statement.zh: LLM agent 透過 text 通訊時，autoregressive decode 會增加延遲，離散 token 投影也會造成資訊損失。Cache-to-Cache 雖避免 text，卻使用 956 MB 的逐位置 adapter，並要求 sharer 與 receiver 的 context 在 token 層級對齊，因此不適用於不同 context 的 agent。

key_innovation.en: Latent Cache Flow jointly translates keys and values through a shared low-dimensional bottleneck with learned gates and layer pruning. Its LCF-X extension hierarchically pools the sharer's full KV cache into a fixed-size, position-free summary that conditions a receiver with a different context.
key_innovation.zh: Latent Cache Flow 以共享的低維 bottleneck 聯合轉換 key 與 value，並結合 learned gate 與 layer pruning。其 LCF-X 擴充透過 hierarchical pooling，將 sharer 的完整 KV cache 彙整為固定大小、與位置無關的 summary，使具有不同 context 的 receiver 能直接據此推論。

baselines_compared: Cache-to-Cache (C2C), Text-to-Text (T2T), Receiver-only, Sharer-only, Optimal-Routing Frontier (ORF)

key_improvements.en: A pruned 13 MB LCF adapter outperforms the 956 MB C2C adapter in shared-context evaluation. Across different contexts, LCF-X improves F1 by 7.5% and Exact Match by 23% over text communication while reducing TTFT from 410 ms to 48 ms (8.5×).
key_improvements.zh: 在 shared-context 評測中，經 pruning 的 13 MB LCF adapter 優於 956 MB 的 C2C adapter。在不同 context 間，LCF-X 相較 text 通訊將 F1 提升 7.5%、Exact Match 提升 23%，並把 TTFT 從 410 ms 降至 48 ms (8.5×)。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100 80GB, NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell

reuse_metric.en: The 9-layer LCF-128 preserves a 31.26 weighted accuracy versus C2C's 29.13 with a 13 MB versus 956 MB projector (76× smaller); LCF-X reaches 35.13 F1 and 25.28 EM across disjoint contexts.
reuse_metric.zh: 9-layer LCF-128 以 13 MB projector 達到 31.26 的 weighted accuracy，優於 C2C 使用 956 MB projector 時的 29.13，容量縮減 76×；LCF-X 在互斥 context 間達到 35.13 F1 與 25.28 EM。
